npcs.text:
When a POKéMON battle starts, the one
at the left of the list goes out first.

So, when you get more POKéMON in your
party, try switching around the order
of your POKéMON.

It could give you an advantage.

When POKéMON battle, they eventually
level up and become stronger.

If the POKéMON with you become
stronger, you'll be able to go farther
away from here.
Please come again!

The clerk says they're all sold out.

If a POKéMON gets hurt and loses its HP
and faints, it won't be able to battle.

To prevent your POKéMON from fainting,
restore its HP with a POTION.

That PC in the corner there is
for any POKéMON TRAINER to use.

Naturally, that means you're welcome
to use it, too.

POKéMON CENTERS are great!

You can use their services as much
as you like, and it's all for free.
You never have to worry!

The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on
the second floor was built recently.

But they say they're still making
adjustments.

My face is reflected in the water.

It's a shining grin full of hope…

Or it could be a look of somber silence
struggling with fear…

What do you see reflected in your face?

Let's say you have six POKéMON.
If you catch another one…

It is automatically sent to a STORAGE
BOX over a PC connection.

Hiya! Are you maybe…
A rookie TRAINER?

Do you know what POKéMON TRAINERS
do when they reach a new town?

They first check what kind of GYM
is in the town.

He's a TRAINER worth my respect.

And, I sense the same glow coming
from you as your father.

I hope that you'll stage a terrific
battle with your father!

npcs.text:
Sigh…

I wish I could go on an adventure
with some POKéMON…

Crawl through some damp grass…
Climb rocky, rugged mountains…

Cross the raging seas…
Wander about in dark caves…

And, sometimes, even get a little
homesick…

It must be fabulous to travel!

Traveling is wonderful!

When I was young, I roamed the seas
and the mountains!

NORMAN became our town's new
GYM LEADER.

I think he called his family over from
somewhere far away.

I battled NORMAN once, but, whew,
he was way too strong.

How would I put it?

I just got the feeling that he
lives for POKéMON.
Please come again!

Do you have any ANTIDOTES with
you?

If you walk around with a poisoned
POKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints.
Take some ANTIDOTES with you.

Do you use REPEL?
It keeps POKéMON away, so it's
useful when you're in a hurry.

Even if a POKéMON is weak now,
it will grow stronger.

The most important thing is love!
Love for your POKéMON!

That PC-based POKéMON Storage
System…

Whoever made it must be some kind
of a scientific wizard!

When my POKéMON ate an
ORAN BERRY, it regained HP!

There are many types of POKéMON.

All types have their strengths and
weaknesses against other types.

Depending on the types of POKéMON,
a battle could be easy or hard.

You're…
Ah, you must be , right?

Thank you for playing with WALLY a
little while ago.

He's been frail and sickly ever
since he was a baby.

We've sent him to stay with my relatives
in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.

The air is a lot cleaner there
than it is here.

What's that? Where's WALLY?
He's already left, our WALLY.

I wonder where he could have
gotten by now?

WALLY was really happy when he told
us that he caught a POKéMON.

It's been ages since I've seen him
smile like that.

Yo, there!
Your POKéMON doing okay?

If your POKéMON are weak and you want
to avoid battles, you should stay out
of tall grass.

I caught a bunch of POKéMON.
Now I'm out of POKé BALLS.

If you have a big BUG POKéMON,
people respect you for it.

Sometimes, there are things on the
ground even if you can't see them.

That's why I always check where I'm
walking.

Oh, neat!
That's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!

You must be a TRAINER.
You should try using this item.

TRAINER TIPS

Any POKéMON that appears even once
in a battle is awarded EXP Points.

To raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the
left of the team list.

As soon as a battle starts, switch it
out. It will earn EXP Points without
being exposed to any harm.

TRAINER TIPS

In addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON
have Power Points (PP) that are used to
make moves during battle.

If a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be
taken to a POKéMON CENTER.

The grass goes up my nose and…
Fwafwafwafwafwa…

Fwatchoo!

I'm going to catch a whole bunch of

I wish I would win soon…

LIV: We work perfectly together,

But we still lost…

AMY: You have to think about all
kinds of things when you're battling
against two TRAINERS.

Gah, I'm still boiling mad…
Grrrrr…

My POKéMON is staggeringly tired…
I should have brought a POTION…

My delightful POKéMON looks darling
even when it's fainted!

Do you like cramped quarters
like this?

I was playing my guitar where few
people were around, but a lot of fans
have gathered.

Heh, maybe I should turn pro.

I'm a poor swimmer so I was practicing…
Sorry for almost crashing into you.

Oh, I understand where you're coming
from now.

If I had a POKéMON that trusty,
I'd want to SURF on it, too!

The sea, huh?

I wonder what it's like at the bottom
of the sea?

That seaside cottage is where
MR. BRINEY lives.

He was once a mighty sailor who never
feared the sea, however stormy.

If you're faced with a decision and
you let someone else choose for you,
you will regret it, however things
turn out.

If you're going to throw a POKé BALL,
weaken the wild POKéMON first.

It will be easier to catch if it's been
poisoned, burned, or lulled to sleep.

You're a thief if you try to steal
someone else's POKéMON.

You should throw POKé BALLS only at
wild POKéMON.

Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER.

But that's right, if TRAINERS lock eyes,
it's a challenge to battle.

If you don't want to battle, stay out
of their sight.

I got too into fishing.
I forgot I had to raise my POKéMON…

If you see BERRIES growing in loamy
soil, feel free to take them.

But make sure you plant a BERRY in the
same spot. That's common courtesy.

Here, I'll share this with you.

GINA: You are strong!
We have to train lots more!

MIA: We will train our POKéMON more
and be strong like you.

There are some things money can't buy.
That's POKéMON…

“Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”
I hope we meet again.

I want to leave my footprints in
the sand everywhere, but they
disappear quickly…

I like filling my mouth with seeds,
then spitting them out fast!

You can have this, so you try it out!

Use it on a POKéMON, and it will learn
a move for firing seeds rapidly.

Hey, MAGIKARP, you sure don't live up
to your name, do you?

npcs.text:
Hello!

This is the PRETTY PETAL flower shop.
Spreading flowers all over the world!

While BERRY plants are growing,
water them with the WAILMER PAIL.

Oh, another thing.

If you don't pick BERRIES for a while,
they'll drop off onto the ground.
But they'll sprout again.

Isn't that awesome?
It's like they have the will to live.

I'm trying to be like my big sisters.
I'm growing flowers, too!

Here you go!
It's for you!
